title: Administrative fee

rate.doc: Fee as a fraction of reported net sales.

report_clause.doc: Name of the Sales-Reporting clause whose reports form the base.

due.doc: Time after each period's end by which the fee is due.

rounding.doc: Rounding applied to each period's fee.

UP:Admin-Fee/paid.doc: The payer attests payment of the fee for the period. Discharges the duty when acknowledged by the payee.

render: For each period of {{period|period}}, {{payer|role}} pays {{payee|role}} an administrative fee equal to {{rate|rate}} of the net sales reported for that period, rounded {{rounding|rounding}}, within {{due|period}} after the period ends. The fee is fixed at that rate for the term of this Agreement unless the Agreement is amended.

title: Audit right

auditor.doc: Role that may request an audit.

response.doc: Time after a request by which records must be made available.

UP:Audit/request.doc: Request for an audit of records within the stated scope and time range.

UP:Audit/available.doc: The auditee attests that the requested records are available. Discharges the duty when acknowledged by the auditor.

render: {{auditor|role}} may request an audit of the records of {{auditee|role}} relating to this Agreement. The number of audit requests may not exceed {{max_requests}} in any period of {{per|period}}. {{auditee|role}} makes the requested records available within {{response|period}} of each request.

title: Fee disclosure

due.doc: Time after each period's end by which the disclosure is due.

UP:Fee-Disclosure/disclosed.doc: The Aggregator states the administrative fees it received from the Supplier for the period under the parent agreement, attributable to this Member where the parent agreement reports by participation.

render: For each period of {{period|period}}, the Aggregator discloses to the Member, in writing, the amount of administrative fees it received from the Supplier under the parent agreement for that period, within {{due|period}} after the period ends. This clause records a disclosure process. It makes no statement about whether any arrangement satisfies any law.

title: Termination for cause

holders.doc: Roles that may terminate for cause.

cure_period.doc: Time allowed to cure after a breach notice.

notice.doc: Time from termination notice to termination.

UP:Termination-Cause/breach.doc: Notice describing an alleged material breach.

UP:Termination-Cause/cured.doc: Statement that the breach identified by the referenced notice has been cured. Effective only when acknowledged by the party that gave the breach notice.

UP:Termination-Cause/notice.doc: Notice of termination for the referenced, uncured breach.

render: If a party commits a material breach, {{holders|role}} may give notice describing it. If the breach is not cured within {{cure_period|period}} of that notice, {{holders|role}} may terminate this Agreement by further notice, effective {{notice|period}} after that notice. A breach counts as cured only when the party that gave the breach notice acknowledges the cure.
